تنتقعن (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِعْنَ (tantaqiʕna) /tan.ta.qiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# تُنْتَقَعْنَ (tuntaqaʕna) /tun.ta.qaʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
